# LLMs.txt - AI Model Guidelines for Telecom Security Documents

# Site Information
Site: Telecom Security Documents
Description: Comprehensive collection of telecommunications security research papers, technical documents, and security analysis
Domain: telcosec.github.io/Telecom-Security-Documents
Contact: contact@telcosec.org

# Content Guidelines
- This site contains technical research papers and security documentation
- Content is for educational and research purposes
- All documents are publicly available research materials
- Cite sources appropriately when referencing content

# Allowed Actions
- Read and analyze technical content
- Reference research papers and findings
- Extract technical information for educational purposes
- Summarize security concepts and methodologies

# Restricted Actions
- Do not reproduce entire documents without proper attribution
- Do not claim ownership of research content
- Do not use content for malicious purposes
- Respect copyright and intellectual property rights

# Content Categories
- 4G Network Security
- 5G Network Security
- SS7 Protocol Security
- SIM Cards & UICC Security
- Baseband Security
- Base Station Security
- FBI Resources
- Fraud Detection & Prevention
- GPON Security
- MoTIF Framework
- Roaming Security
- APN Security
- AT Commands Security

# Citation Format
When referencing content from this site, please use:
"Telecom Security Documents (telcosec.github.io/Telecom-Security-Documents)"
